# make sure you've run FIA-fire-severity and control-plot-species before running this script

library(terra)
library(dplyr)


# get coordinates for your filtered plots
CA_PLOT_coords <- CA_PLOT_forest_type %>%
  dplyr::select(plot_id, LON, LAT) %>%   # adjust column names if different
  distinct()

# convert to a terra SpatVector, matching raster CRS
plot_pts <- vect(CA_PLOT_coords, geom = c("LON", "LAT"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

if (!same.crs(plot_pts, climate_stack)) {
  plot_pts <- project(plot_pts, crs(climate_stack))
}

climate_vals <- terra::extract(climate_stack, plot_pts)

# rename columns explicitly (skip the first column, which is "ID")
colnames(climate_vals) <- c("ID", "ppt", "def", "vpd", "aet", "pet", "tmax", "tmin")

CA_PLOT_climate <- bind_cols(CA_PLOT_coords, climate_vals %>% dplyr::select(-ID))


library(ggplot2)

species_climate_full <- CA_TREE_forest_type_species %>%
  left_join(CA_PLOT_climate, by = "plot_id") %>%
  left_join(tcrit_species_avg, by = "species") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Tcrit))

ggplot(species_climate_full, aes(x = vpd, y = Tcrit)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "VPD", y = "Mean Tcrit (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()

species_climate_summary <- CA_TREE_forest_type_species %>%
  left_join(CA_PLOT_climate, by = "plot_id") %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_vpd = mean(vpd, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_vpd = sd(vpd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(tcrit_species_avg, by = "species") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Tcrit))

CA_TREE_forest_type_species %>%
  left_join(CA_PLOT_climate, by = "plot_id") %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tcrit_df %>% filter(run != "run7") %>% group_by(species) %>% summarise(Tcrit = mean(Tcrit, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = "species"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Tcrit)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_tmax, y = Tcrit)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = species), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey50") +
  labs(x = "Mean Tmax", y = "Mean Tcrit (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()



library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- 1. Check plot density across the climate gradient before stratifying ----

ggplot(CA_PLOT_climate, aes(x = tmax)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(x = "Tmax", y = "Number of plots") +
  theme_minimal()

# ---- 2. Bin plots into equal-width climate bins and sample evenly across them ----

n_bins <- 10
n_per_bin <- 50

set.seed(123)

CA_PLOT_climate_binned <- CA_PLOT_climate %>%
  filter(!is.na(tmax)) %>%
  mutate(climate_bin = cut(tmax, breaks = n_bins))

# check how many plots are available per bin before sampling
CA_PLOT_climate_binned %>% count(climate_bin)

CA_PLOT_climate_stratified <- CA_PLOT_climate_binned %>%
  group_by(climate_bin) %>%
  slice_sample(n = n_per_bin, replace = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# confirm how many plots you actually got per bin (some bins may have fewer than n_per_bin)
CA_PLOT_climate_stratified %>% count(climate_bin)

# ---- 3. Filter the plot and tree networks down to the stratified plot set ----

stratified_plot_ids <- CA_PLOT_climate_stratified %>% pull(plot_id)

CA_PLOT_forest_type_stratified <- CA_PLOT_forest_type %>%
  filter(plot_id %in% stratified_plot_ids)

CA_TREE_forest_type_species_stratified <- CA_TREE_forest_type_species %>%
  filter(plot_id %in% stratified_plot_ids)

# ---- 4. Calculate basal area per tree (stratified set only) ----

CA_TREE_BA <- CA_TREE_forest_type_species_stratified %>%
  mutate(basal_area = pi * (DIA / 2)^2)  # DIA usually in inches; fine as a relative weight

# ---- 5. Compute community-weighted mean (CWM) Tcrit per plot per year ----

CWM_by_plot_year <- CA_TREE_BA %>%
  left_join(tcrit_species_avg, by = "species") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Tcrit), !is.na(basal_area)) %>%
  group_by(plot_id, INVYR) %>%
  summarise(
    cwm_tcrit = sum(basal_area * Tcrit) / sum(basal_area),
    total_ba = sum(basal_area),
    n_species = n_distinct(species),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- 6. Visualize CWM Tcrit over time ----

# scatter + linear trend
ggplot(CWM_by_plot_year, aes(x = INVYR, y = cwm_tcrit)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "Inventory Year", y = "Community-weighted mean Tcrit (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()

# boxplot by year
ggplot(CWM_by_plot_year, aes(x = factor(INVYR), y = cwm_tcrit)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Inventory Year", y = "Community-weighted mean Tcrit (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()

# ---- 7. (Optional) Mixed model accounting for repeated plot measurements ----
# Only meaningful if plots are resurveyed over multiple INVYR values.
# Check first:
CWM_by_plot_year %>% count(plot_id) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% nrow()

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
cwm_trend <- lmer(cwm_tcrit ~ INVYR + (1 | plot_id), data = CWM_by_plot_year)
summary(cwm_trend)
